turns.assessment: The fault is localized to oms.S20-S08.amp4. Its input power and pump current did not change, while its output fell about 4.73 dB; the same loss then appeared at downstream amplifiers and across essentially all monitored channels at S08. This directly matches an amplifier gain drop and rules strongly against upstream span loss, gain tilt, noise-figure rise, or pump failure.

proposals.rationale: AMP_GAIN_OOR originated on amp4, with unchanged input power but a 4.73 dB output-power decrease. Downstream amplifier inputs/outputs and all S08 channel powers show the same approximately 4.7 dB reduction.
A tilt fault could lower some channels, but the nearly uniform loss across the monitored spectrum strongly contradicts it.
